method: Fresh standalone deep dive and retest against current municipal pages, current Omgevingsplan, current onzelfstandige-bewoning policy, current opkoopbescherming regulation/form and current 2026 fee regulation.

legalFramework.kamerverhuur: An omgevingsvergunning is required to use a property for room rental. Enschede maintains a current map of legal room-rental properties and pending applications, making location/spread part of the practical assessment.
legalFramework.onzelfstandigeBewoningPolicy: Beleidsregel Onzelfstandige Bewoning Enschede 2022 remains current. The policy evaluates new/expanded room-rental applications for impact on the residential and living environment after the quantitative/spatial test; new room rental is not accepted where the living environment is considered vulnerable, subject to policy-specific exceptions/assessment.
legalFramework.hospitaverhuur: No permit is required where the municipal hospita conditions are met: owner/occupant has main residence in the dwelling, permissions from landlord/mortgage provider where applicable, rental to at most one household, adult tenant with rental contract, no family/ex-partner, and both owner/occupant and tenant registered at the address.
legalFramework.omgevingsplan: Current Omgevingsplan contains residential occupancy and splitting rules. It includes an over-occupancy rule of max one person per 12 m2 usable area for a dwelling and prohibits constructional splitting of existing dwellings into multiple ground-based dwellings in specified residential working areas.
legalFramework.woningsplitsing: Municipal enforcement information explicitly treats splitting a building into multiple independent dwellings as an activity for which permit legality must be checked. A separate house-number application is not needed when an omgevingsvergunning is filed for splitting because numbering is handled with that permit.
legalFramework.opkoopbescherming: Applies in Binnensingelgebied, Hogeland-Velve, Twekkelerveld-T.H.T., Boswinkel-Stadsveld, Enschede-Noord and Enschede-Zuid. For 2026 the municipal threshold is WOZ EUR 365000. The current regulation runs through 2026 and the restriction applies for four years to qualifying acquisitions; new dwellings younger than three months and already-rented dwellings are among stated exclusions.

kamerverhuurAndSplitting.precheck: Vergunningcheck; concept request available for applicable activities
knownAssessmentInputs: address/location and current legal/pending room-rental map
building/technical information where splitting or alteration is involved
kamerverhuurAndSplitting.staticAttachmentRule: No universal static attachment list is encoded unless the live product/Omgevingsloket explicitly requires it.

baseRequiredDataDocuments: proof of registration of deed of transfer at Kadaster
opkoopbescherming.additionalDocuments: exception-specific documents are requested by the live form
opkoopbescherming.bibob: municipal page states a Bibob investigation is performed for a rental-permit application and instructs applicant to add a completed Bibob form

leegstandswet.note: kept as a separate temporary-letting product; not conflated with ordinary room rental or opkoopbescherming

sourceCurrentness.currentPolicy: Beleidsregel Onzelfstandige Bewoning Enschede 2022, current from 2023 to present
sourceCurrentness.currentOpkoopRegulation: current version effective from 13-12-2024 to present; original regulation is scheduled to expire 01-01-2027

remaining: representative-address check against current Omgevingsplan and legal/pending kamerverhuur map
extract exact quantitative/spatial outcome and liveability assessment for a concrete room-rental address
capture live Omgevingsloket-generated attachment list and exact composed 2026 fee for a concrete room-rental/splitting project
for opkoopbescherming, map the address to a protected district and capture exception-specific documents from the live form where an exception is invoked
closureAssessment: Standalone generic legal/product research is substantially complete. The remaining questions are legitimately address/map/case dependent or dynamically generated by Omgevingsloket. Enschede therefore does not require further broad municipal research before batch closure.
